name: NuclearQAv2 — Aggregate
protocol: NuclearQAv2 arXiv-v1 1,239-question snapshot: Boolean v2, Numeric v0, Verbal v0; three runs per model and task-count-weighted aggregate.

explanation.en: Boolean exact match, 15%-tolerance numeric accuracy, and fixed GPT-J semantic verbal judgments are weighted by task counts.
explanation.zh: 判断题精确匹配、允许 15% 误差的数值题和固定 GPT-J 语义裁判的概念题按题量加权。

summary.en: NuclearQAv2 evaluates factual, numerical, and conceptual nuclear-engineering reasoning.
summary.zh: NuclearQAv2 评估核工程事实知识、数值计算和概念推理能力。

task_format.en: The model answers 1,239 Boolean, numerical, and short verbal nuclear-engineering questions.
task_format.zh: 模型回答 1,239 道核工程判断、数值和简短概念题。
